summary: All 3 acceptance criteria verified: secret displayed once, revoke-one preserves others + disconnect-all invalidates all, and accessible loading/connected/attention/error states are tested. All 114 frontend tests pass; typecheck and lint clean.
important_context: Playwright caldav-account.spec.ts is a DAV API tracer, not a lifecycle UI test; the task slice doc mentions 'Playwright lifecycle with immediate DAV failure after revoke' as a verify step but it is not part of the task JSON acceptance criteria and no such Playwright test exists.
